name: plain/correct-on-time
note: Plain incident, onset 10 s, deadline 40 s. The truth declared at 12 s, anchored on one of the incident's observations.

name: plain/correct-exactly-at-deadline
note: A correct declaration at exactly the deadline is on time.

name: plain/correct-one-nanosecond-late
note: One nanosecond after the deadline: a correct declaration, not on time, so the incident is missed. first_correct_at is still recorded.

name: plain/critical-late-is-a-critical-miss
note: Critical plain incident, deadline 30 s, correct declaration at 35 s: late, so missed, and a critical miss.

name: plain/critical-correct-on-time-is-no-miss
note: Critical plain incident declared correctly at 20 s, deadline 30 s: no miss.

name: plain/silent-is-missed
note: Nothing declared about a non-critical plain incident: missed, not a critical miss.

name: plain/silent-critical-is-a-critical-miss
note: Nothing declared about a critical plain incident.

name: plain/right-kind-wrong-site
note: Kind matches, site does not: one wrong declaration, missed.

name: plain/right-site-wrong-kind
note: Site matches, kind does not.

name: plain/none-is-wrong-and-no-false-alarm
note: Declaring 'not an incident' about a real plain incident is a wrong declaration and not a false alarm.

name: plain/wrong-then-right-in-time
note: Wrong at 15 s, right at 20 s, deadline 40 s: correct by deadline with one wrong declaration. The wrong one does not cancel the right one.

name: plain/right-then-wrong
note: Right at 15 s, then wrong at 20 s: still correct by deadline, one wrong declaration. There is no retraction.

name: plain/two-correct-declarations
note: Two correct declarations: both counted, first_correct_at is the earlier.

name: plain/late-then-wrong-keeps-the-late-time
note: Correct only at 50 s (late), wrong at 55 s: missed, one correct and one wrong declaration.

name: plain/hypothesis-anchored-in-the-other-incident
note: Incident 0's truth declared with an anchor in incident 1: wrong about incident 1, nothing about incident 0. The anchor chooses the incident, not the hypothesis.

name: plain/recurrence-is-told-apart-by-the-anchor
note: Incident 1 repeats incident 0 (same kind and site). The truth anchored in incident 0 at 105 s is late for incident 0 and does nothing for incident 1; anchored in incident 1 at 110 s it is on time.

name: hard/correct-on-time
note: Hard incident declared with its hard kind and site, inside the deadline.

name: hard/imitated-known-kind-is-wrong
note: The cheap rung's answer: the imitated known kind at the hard incident's true site. Wrong.

name: hard/right-hard-kind-at-the-wrong-site
note: The hard kind is right and the site is not.

name: hard/a-different-hard-family-is-wrong
note: Truth is a cascade at service 2; the declaration says split brain at service 2.

name: hard/critical-silent-is-a-critical-miss
note: Critical hard incident, nothing declared.

name: hard/critical-late-is-a-critical-miss
note: Critical hard incident with deadline 40 s, correct at 45 s.

name: hard/all-four-kinds-correct
note: One incident of each hard kind, each declared correctly five seconds after onset.

name: decoy/declared-as-an-incident
note: A decoy declared as a configuration drift at 12 s: a false alarm.

name: decoy/dismissed
note: A decoy declared 'not an incident' at 20 s: a correct dismissal. A decoy has no deadline, so it is never 'by deadline' and never missed.

name: decoy/silent-is-neither
note: Nothing declared about a decoy: not a false alarm, not a dismissal, not missed.

name: decoy/alarm-then-dismissal-is-not-netted
note: Alarmed at 12 s, dismissed at 30 s: both counted, neither cancels the other.

name: decoy/dismissal-long-after-resolution
note: Dismissed at 500 s, long after it resolved: still a correct dismissal. A decoy has no deadline.

name: decoy/two-false-alarms-count-twice
note: Two false alarms about one decoy, one with a hard hypothesis: two false alarms, one alarmed decoy.

name: decoy/every-decoy-is-in-exactly-one-or-two-categories
note: Four decoys: silent; alarmed; dismissed; alarmed and dismissed. dismissed 2, alarmed 2, silent 1, false alarms 2.

name: background/some-is-a-false-alarm
note: An incident declared with an anchor on a background observation: a false alarm about nothing.

name: background/none-is-nothing
note: 'Not an incident' anchored on background is correct and counts for nothing.

name: background/mini-burst-beside-an-incident
note: A claim anchored on a background observation, then the truth anchored in the incident: one false alarm on background, the incident correct.

name: escalation/needed-hard
note: One informed, correct escalation about a hard incident with three references. Cost 460 tokens, 115 ms modelled.

name: escalation/unneeded-plain
note: An uninformed but lucky escalation about a plain incident: unneeded, correct, not informed.

name: escalation/unneeded-decoy
note: An escalation about a decoy with an empty context: unneeded; 400 tokens.

name: escalation/background
note: An informed escalation whose focus is a background observation: background class, no incident touched.

name: escalation/informed-and-uninformed-on-one-hard-incident
note: Two calls about one hard incident: an uninformed one with no context, then an informed one with four references; then the correct declaration. Counted per incident and in the totals.

name: escalation/repeats-count-again
note: Three escalations about one hard incident: three needed calls, one hard incident escalated.

name: escalation/after-the-deadline-is-still-needed
note: Escalating about a hard incident at 70 s, after its 50 s deadline, is still counted needed: the class is the incident's tier, not the timing.

name: escalation/refused-calls-and-declarations-count-for-nothing
note: A refused escalation (reasoner budget), a refused declaration with an unknown anchor, and a refused declaration past the end: no declaration, no escalation, no cost, no check of their anchors.

name: escalation/probes-are-not-scored
note: Accepted probes change nothing in the verdict: the reasoner's cost is counted, probes are the harness's accounting.

name: escalation/mixed-stream
note: Five incidents of all three tiers, five calls (one about background), declarations including a false alarm on a decoy and one on background. Hand-computed totals.

name: totals/empty-stream
note: No incidents, no observations, no steps: all zeros and no per-incident rows.

name: totals/untouched-incidents-are-counted
note: Three incidents, one of each tier, one of them critical, and no steps: all counted, the plain and hard ones missed, the decoy silent.

name: totals/wrong-declarations-sum-plain-and-hard-only
note: Two wrong declarations about a plain incident, one about a hard one, and one false alarm about a decoy: wrong_declarations is 3, false_alarms is 1.

name: error/time-goes-backwards
note: A declaration at 20 s, then one at 15 s.

name: error/equal-instants-are-allowed
note: Two declarations at the same instant are fine.

name: error/refused-step-going-backwards-is-still-an-error
note: A refused step earlier than its predecessor is still time going backwards.

name: error/declare-answered-by-escalated
note: A Declare whose outcome is Escalated.

name: error/probe-answered-by-declared
note: A Probe whose outcome is Declared.

name: error/escalate-answered-by-probed
note: An Escalate whose outcome is Probed, after one good step.

name: error/accepted-declaration-after-the-end
note: A Declared outcome one nanosecond after the stream's end.

name: error/accepted-escalation-after-the-end
note: An Escalated outcome after the stream's end.

name: error/accepted-probe-after-the-end
note: A Probed outcome after the stream's end.

name: error/declaration-exactly-at-the-end-is-allowed
note: An accepted declaration at exactly the duration is allowed (late for the incident, so missed).

name: error/refused-past-duration-is-an-ordinary-refusal
note: The stream refuses everything past its end with PastDuration; the trajectory may hold that refusal.

name: error/anchor-is-not-an-observation
note: Two observations exist; the accepted declaration is anchored on the third.

name: error/focus-is-not-an-observation
note: An accepted escalation whose focus is not in the stream.

name: error/anchor-before-the-incident-began
note: An accepted declaration anchored in an incident, one nanosecond before its onset.

name: error/focus-before-the-incident-began
note: An accepted escalation whose focus is in an incident that has not begun.

name: error/anchor-at-the-onset-is-allowed
note: A declaration at exactly the incident's onset is allowed.

name: error/background-anchor-needs-no-onset
note: A background observation is not held to any incident's onset.

name: error/escalation-call-index-out-of-order
note: The first accepted escalation carries call 1, not 0.

name: error/escalation-without-a-call-summary
note: An accepted escalation and no call summaries.

name: error/call-summary-at-disagrees
note: The summary says the call was made 1 ns after the step.

name: error/call-summary-ready-at-disagrees
note: The summary's ready_at is not the outcome's.

name: error/call-summary-refs-disagree
note: The step has two references and the summary one.

name: error/call-summary-focus-disagrees
note: The summary names a different focus than the step.

name: error/call-summary-focus-agrees-is-fine
note: A summary that records the focus and agrees with the step.

name: error/extra-call-summaries
note: No escalation in the trajectory and one call summary.

name: error/one-extra-call-summary-after-an-escalation
note: One accepted escalation and two call summaries.

name: error/incident-ids-are-not-positions
note: The second incident has id 2.

name: error/decoy-with-a-true-diagnosis
note: A decoy whose truth is Some.

name: error/decoy-with-a-deadline
note: A decoy with a deadline.

name: error/decoy-that-is-critical
note: A critical decoy.

name: error/plain-incident-without-a-truth
note: A plain incident whose truth is None.

name: error/hard-incident-without-a-deadline
note: A hard incident with no deadline.

name: error/label-of-an-unknown-incident
note: An observation labelled with incident 3 in a truth of one incident.

name: error/time-beats-outcome-at-the-same-step
note: Step 1 is both earlier than step 0 and has the wrong outcome: time is reported.

name: error/outcome-beats-the-end
note: A mismatching outcome after the end: the mismatch is reported.

name: error/end-beats-unknown-observation
note: An accepted declaration after the end, anchored on a missing observation: the end is reported.

name: error/unknown-observation-beats-call-record
note: An accepted escalation with an unknown focus and no call summary: the observation is reported.

name: error/not-yet-emitted-beats-call-record
note: An accepted escalation about an incident that has not begun and with no call summary: not-yet-emitted is reported.

name: error/truth-is-checked-before-any-step
note: An invalid truth and a trajectory that goes backwards: the truth is reported.

name: error/incident-ids-beat-tier-and-labels
note: Three truth defects at once: ids are reported first.

name: error/tier-beats-labels
note: A tier defect and an unknown label together: the tier defect is reported.

name: error/first-offending-step-is-reported
note: A good step, then going backwards at index 2 and a bad outcome at index 3: index 2.

name: error/step-errors-beat-the-call-count
note: A step that goes backwards and an extra call summary: the step is reported.
